subject: Kestrel: integration recommendation decisions
body:
Team,

Kestrel decisions from today's review:

1. The integration recommendation goes forward on flat structure annotations only. Linnea's numbers (79.8% vs 71.4%, with trees adding barely a point at real pipeline cost) make this easy — the brittle xlink-dependent tree path moves to a Q3 research item, not a launch dependency.
2. Model-negative training is mandatory in the recommended recipe; rule-based-only configs are documented as a fast-start option.
3. Handoff: Yara writes the recommendation memo with Linnea by 5/20; I'll walk it into the query-understanding team's planning ahead of Q3 OKR lock on 6/26.

This one lands inside the window with room to spare — nice work.

Dmitri
